about.heading: Why HetAas Atelier?
about.subtitle: Poured & polished with love in Ahmedabad, Gujarat since 2022
about.story: Born out of a deep love for botanical art, HetAas Atelier transforms organic pressed flowers, foil accents, and high-clarity resin into timeless keepsakes. From personalized golden name keychains to sacred pooja thalis and home decor, every single creation is individually poured, cured over 4 to 6 days, and polished by hand in our studio.

faqs.q: How do I place an order?
faqs.a: Add your desired items (either standard shop items or customized creations) to your Resin Basket. When ready, open the basket and click checkout. This copies a fully detailed order list to your clipboard and opens Instagram DM so you can paste and send it directly!

faqs.q: What are the payment and refund rules?
faqs.a: We accept pre-paid orders only. Since all items are handcrafted and customized specifically for you, no returns, refunds, or exchanges are accepted.

faqs.q: How long does it take to make customized items?
faqs.a: Resin curing is a slow, artistic process. It takes around 4 to 6 days to design, pour, bubble-pop, and fully cure a customized order before it can be collected or dispatched.
We do not offer free shipping. Customers in Ahmedabad can arrange a self-pickup. If you want us to ship anywhere else across India, the delivery costs must be borne entirely by the buyer.
